job.job_description:
Experience working in asset management and/or financial services industry
Highly motivated and self-directed with a strong sense of ownership and a delivery mindset
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams

Qualifications

In addition to the above, the following are required qualifications

Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or relevant field
Extensive hands-on engineering experience within asset management or the broader financial services industry, with a focus on delivering scalable and secure technology solutions
Proficiency with FastAPI and/or Django Framework, including the development of RESTful services, and a strong background in Python
Expert in front-end technologies, with significant UX/UI design experience and proven ability implementing sophisticated UIs using ReactJS
